notes:
Lead source: organic self-serve sign-up from indie dev newsletter. Small studio (11-50 eng/design), consumer social gaming (live lobbies and 1:1 chat).

Key constraints / asks:
- Primary: real-time chat UX in mobile/web lobbies; target p95 latency <100ms (goal) for short messages; sub-200ms acceptable for many flows.
- Throughput: expected peak 20-40 qps across several rooms, bursty patterns on evenings/weekends.
- Cost: highly cost-sensitive; will prioritize small model footprint or token efficiency. Wants clear per-token math + examples.
- Abuse & moderation: most important. Need built-in moderation pipeline + ability to plug rules (bad words, spam detection, user scoring). Want webhook for flagged events.
- Model choices: prefer hosted curated models (smaller/lite) or Redwood recommendations; open to baseline Llama-family variants if we provide latency/cost numbers.
- Features wanted: streaming responses, function-calling for structured assistant (player actions), message-level caching for repeated prompts, rolling back to cheaper fallback model on heavy load.

What we've delivered so far:
- Sent quickstart link and sample moderation configs (2026-03-10).
- Shared short runbook for websocket + streaming integration and example SDK snippet.
- Provisioned trial org and minor quota bump to test peak bursts.

Quotes from CTO Sara Kim: "We need something that just works in prod with predictable cost — we don't want to manage model servers yet. If hosted API meets latency and has solid moderation, we can move fast."

Open questions / risks:
- Will hosted API hit p95 latency requirement from their regions (primary NA, some EU)? Need benchmark report or synthetic test.
- Moderation efficacy: need sample false-positive/false-negative rates for standard rules.
- Cost modeling: wants an example monthly spend at 30 qps with conservative token counts.

Recommended next actions:
- Share Redwood-hosted latency benchmark for target region and a quick synthetic test steps they can run in 24h.
- Provide moderation policy templates + webhook example.
- Offer short call to walk through cost calculator during trial (30m).
